@sidebarProjects.description: Sidebar section listing the workspace projects.

@sidebarTasks.description: Sidebar item: the task queue of all projects.

@sidebarGlobalSettings.description: Sidebar item: global settings (providers, tokens, UI language).

@addProject.description: Button that opens the folder picker.

dropHint: Or drop folders onto the window
emptyHint: Add a source folder to scan and translate its comments.

@stateLoading.description: Project state: quick load in progress.

@statePending.description: Project state: has comments waiting for translation.

@tokInput.description: Accessible name of the masked token input.

@tokPlaceholderNew.description: Placeholder of the token input when no token is saved.

tokPlaceholderReplace: Paste a new token to replace the saved one

@tokPlaceholderReplace.description: Placeholder of the token input when a token is already saved.

@tokShow.description: Toggle that temporarily shows what is being typed in the token input (never the saved token).

@tokSave.description: Button that saves (or replaces) the typed token in the system credential store.

@tokSaved.description: Status of a saved token: only its last 4 characters are ever shown.

@tokNotSaved.description: Status when no token is saved at this level.

@tokInUse.description: Which layer the effective token of the project comes from.

@tokSourceProject.description: Token source: the project's own token in the credential store.

@tokSourceGlobal.description: Token source: the selected profile's global token in the credential store.

tokSourceFile: plain text in a config file

@tokSourceFile.description: Token source: a legacy plaintext field in a config file.

tokGlobalHint: Stored in the system credential store. Every project using this profile uses it, unless the project has its own token or an environment variable is set.

@tokDelete.description: Button that asks to delete the saved token.

@tokDeleteTitle.description: Title of the token deletion confirmation.

tokDeleteMessage: It is removed from the system credential store. The CLI and git hooks stop using it too.

@tokDeleteMessage.description: Message of the token deletion confirmation.

@tokDeleteConfirm.description: Confirm button of the token deletion dialog.

tokBlocked: This project points the provider to a different address, so the global token is not sent there. Save a project token to use this address.

@tokBlocked.description: Warning when the project overrides the base URL / endpoint and the global token is withheld.

tokPlaintext: A token is stored in plain text: {locations}

@tokPlaintext.description: Warning bar when config files contain plaintext tokens.

@tokMigrate.description: Button that migrates plaintext tokens into the system credential store.

@tokTest.description: Button that sends a short request with the effective settings and token.

@tokTesting.description: Shown while the connection test runs.

@tokTestFailed.description: Connection test failed (the error never contains the token).

@psTitle.description: Title of the project settings page.

@psBack.description: Button returning from project settings to the project overview.

psIntro: Each value is inherited from the defaults or your global settings unless this project overrides it. Overrides are saved in the project's .codei18n/config.json.

@psIntro.description: Explanation at the top of the project settings page.

@psLegend.description: Label before the legend of source layers.

@psFieldSourceLanguage.description: Project field: language of the code comments.

@psFieldLocalLanguage.description: Project field: language the comments are translated to.

@psFieldProfile.description: Project field: the global provider profile the project uses.

@psFieldProvider.description: Project field: translation provider (openai / ollama / mock).

@psFieldExcludePatterns.description: Project field: glob patterns of files to skip.

@psFieldDetectLanguages.description: Project field: languages the comment language detector considers.

@psSourceDefault.description: Source badge: the value is the built-in default.

@psSourceGlobal.description: Source badge: the value comes from the global settings (or the selected profile).

@psSourceProject.description: Source badge: the value is overridden in this project's config.

@psSourceOverride.description: Source badge: the value is a temporary override of this session.

@psOverride.description: Button saving the edited value into the project's config.

@psReset.description: Button removing the field from the project's config so it is inherited again.

psResetHint: Remove this value from the project and inherit it again

@psResetAll.description: Button removing every field from the project's config.

psResetAllMessage: Every value saved in this project's config is removed and inherited again.

@psResetAllMessage.description: Message of the restore-all confirmation when no project token is saved.

psResetAllTokenMessage: Every value saved in this project's config is removed and inherited again. Do you also want to delete this project's own API token?

@psResetAllTokenMessage.description: Message of the restore-all confirmation when a project token is saved.

@psResetAllConfirm.description: Confirm button of the restore-all dialog when no project token is saved.

@psKeepToken.description: Restore-all dialog: restore inheritance but keep the project token.

@psDeleteToken.description: Restore-all dialog: restore inheritance and delete the project token.

@psTokenTitle.description: Heading of the project's own API token.

psTokenHint: A project token is used only by this project and takes priority over the profile's global token.

@gsTitle.description: Title of the global settings page.

@gsProfiles.description: Heading of the list of global provider profiles.

gsNoProfiles: No profiles yet. Create one to configure a translation provider.

@gsNoProfiles.description: Shown when there is no profile.

@gsNewProfileName.description: Input for the name of a new profile.

@gsCopy.description: Button duplicating the selected profile (without its token).

@gsDelete.description: Button asking to delete the selected profile.

@gsDeleteTitle.description: Title of the profile deletion confirmation.

gsDeleteMessage: Its saved API token is deleted from the system credential store too. Projects using this profile fall back to the default.

@gsDeleteMessage.description: Message of the profile deletion confirmation.

@gsDeleteConfirm.description: Confirm button of the profile deletion dialog.

@gsUseDefault.description: Button making the selected profile the global default.

@gsName.description: Profile field: name (changing it renames the profile and keeps its token).

@gsBatchSize.description: Profile field: comments per request (empty = default).

@gsTokenTitle.description: Heading of the selected profile's API token.

@gsApp.description: Heading of the desktop app's own settings.

@gsLanguage.description: Setting: language of this app's interface.

@gsLanguageSystem.description: Interface language option: use the system's language.

gsLanguageHint: Only changes the language of this app. Each project's translation language is set in its project settings.

@gsLanguageHint.description: Explains that the UI language is independent from the projects' translation target language.

gsWatch: Watch project files and rescan in the background
gsWatchHint: Changed files are scanned incrementally; nothing is translated automatically.

@gsMaxParallel.description: Setting: how many projects batch tasks run at once.

@gsMaxParallelLabel.description: Accessible name of the parallel projects stepper.

gsMaxParallelHint: 1 runs batch tasks one project at a time.

@gsMaxParallelHint.description: Explanation of the parallel projects limit.

@ovNotInitTitle.description: Overview of a project without a .codei18n configuration.

ovNotInitHint: Initializing writes the Codei18n configuration (languages, exclude rules, provider) into the project folder. Your source files are not changed.

@ovLoading.description: Shown while the quick load runs.

@ovProjectError.description: Last load or task error of the project; error is already redacted.

@ovStatComments.description: Stat card: number of comments in the mappings.

@ovStatTranslated.description: Stat card: comments that have a text in the local language.

@ovStatPending.description: Stat card: comments waiting for translation.

@ovStatFailed.description: Stat card: comments whose last translation failed.

@ovLanguages.description: Heading of the detected source language distribution.

@ovNoLanguages.description: Shown when the language distribution is empty.

@ovLangCount.description: One entry of the language distribution; lang is a language code.

@ovActions.description: Heading of the project action buttons.

@ovScan.description: Button: scan the project and extract comments (incremental).

@ovTranslate.description: Button: translate comments that have no local text.

@ovPrune.description: Button: remove mapping entries whose comments no longer exist.

@ovPruneCount.description: Prune button when the last scan found orphans.

@ovRetryFailed.description: Button: translate again the comments that failed last time.

@ovSettings.description: Button opening the project settings page.

@ovRemove.description: Button removing the project from the workspace (files stay on disk).

ovRemoveMessage: The project stays on disk; only its entry in this workspace is removed.

@ovRemoveConfirm.description: Confirm button of the remove confirmation.

@ovProgress.description: Heading of the running task section.

@ovCancelJob.description: Button cancelling the running task of this project.

ovQueued: {count, plural, one {# task queued} other {# tasks queued}}

@ovQueued.description: Number of queued tasks of this project.

@ovProgressCount.description: Progress counter of the running task.

@ovConcurrency.description: Label of the per-project translation concurrency input.

ovConcurrencyHint: Batches translated in parallel; 0 uses the project setting.

@ovConcurrencyHint.description: Hint next to the concurrency input.

@ovLastResult.description: Heading of the last finished task summary.

ovUnchanged: Nothing changed since the last scan.

@ovUnchanged.description: Summary of a scan that found no changes.

ovOrphans: {count, plural, one {# orphaned entry can be pruned.} other {# orphaned entries can be pruned.}}

@ovOrphans.description: Shown after a scan that found orphaned mapping entries.

ovPruneResult: {count, plural, =0 {No orphaned entries to prune.} one {Pruned # orphaned entry.} other {Pruned # orphaned entries.}}
ovFileErrors: {count, plural, one {# file could not be parsed.} other {# files could not be parsed.}}

@ovFileErrors.description: Files skipped by the scan because they failed to parse.

ovJobCanceled: {kind} was canceled; finished work is saved.

@ovJobCanceled.description: Summary of a canceled task; kind is a task kind label.

@ovJobFailed.description: Summary of a failed task; error is already redacted.

@taskPhaseStarting.description: Progress phase before the first event arrives.

@taskPhaseDiscover.description: Progress phase: enumerating files to scan.

@taskPhaseScan.description: Progress phase: parsing files and extracting comments.

@taskPhaseMap.description: Progress phase: merging comments into the mappings.

@taskPhaseIndex.description: Progress phase: writing the location index.

@taskPhaseTranslate.description: Progress phase: calling the translation provider.

@taskPhaseSave.description: Progress phase: writing results to disk.

taskHint: Check projects, then queue the same task for all of them.

@taskHint.description: Hint under the tasks page title.

@taskSelectAll.description: Checkbox checking or unchecking every project.

@taskSelectProject.description: Accessible name of a project's checkbox.

@taskScanSelected.description: Button queueing a scan for every checked project.

@taskTranslateSelected.description: Button queueing a translation for every checked project.

@taskCancelAll.description: Button cancelling every queued and running task.

@taskClearFinished.description: Button removing finished tasks from the list.

@taskParallel.description: Label of the global parallel-limit input.

taskParallelHint: 1 runs the projects one after another.

@taskParallelHint.description: Hint next to the parallel-limit input.

taskNoProjects: Add projects to run batch tasks.

@taskCancelJob.description: Button cancelling one task in the list.

@wizProfile.description: Wizard field: the translation provider profile.

@wizInstallHooks.description: Wizard checkbox: install the pre-commit hook.
